body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Meridian presented ''MV-D1'', its new converter during CES 2007, which can convert general SD quality video files to full HD(1080p) quality video . According to the company, the MV-D1 allows you to view the video contents stored in your iPod in full HD quality large screen.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
